body: MLX: An array framework for Apple silicon
plain_description: **Build and train machine learning models on Apple silicon.** Use familiar Python, C++, C, or Swift APIs. MLX supports work with language models, image generation, and speech recognition.
technical_description: MLX is an array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon, with Python, C++, C, and Swift APIs. It supports automatic differentiation, vectorization, computation graph optimization, lazy computation, dynamic graph construction, and CPU/GPU operations using unified memory. Examples include transformer language model training, text generation, LoRA fine-tuning, image generation, and speech recognition.
title: MLX
